question: The dataset contains pre-computed cluster labels from two methods: K-means and hierarchical clustering (columns: kmeans_label and hierarchical_label). Compute the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) to quantify the agreement between these two sets of cluster assignments.

files.eval_guideline: The ARI value must match the reference within +/-0.001; whitespace and decimal precision may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Both files have the identical name adjusted_rand_index.txt and matching plain-text (.txt) format. Their task paths and filenames clearly correspond to the requested ARI result comparing kmeans_label and hierarchical_label.
files.strategy_reasoning: The output is a single numeric ARI computed deterministically from pre-computed labels. Apply the guideline’s absolute tolerance of ±0.001 directly; omit the numeric strategy’s relative-error tolerance because it is not equivalent without knowing the reference value.
